title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
abstract: arXiv:2611.30149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. translated_title: LeadVLA：学习面向跟随者的路线执行以实现机器人领行
translated_abstract: 机器人领行需要在执行路线的同时持续适应指定的跟随者。现有的机器人领行系统通常通过显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来协调对跟随者的理解与物理路线执行；而直接通过端到端轨迹预测学习这种耦合，反而可能将路线执行与跟随者响应纠缠在一起。我们提出了LeadVLA，这是一种结构化多模态策略，它将路线保留为显式的路径参考，同时学习用于路线推进的节奏，以及用于局部跟随者与场景条件自适应的残差。为了使该问题可训练、可度量，我们开发了LeadInfra——一个基于Unreal Engine的可配置闭环数据生成基础设施，并从中构建了约400万样本的训练语料库；同时开发了LeadBench——一个包含108个完全留出闭环回合的标准化基准。LeadVLA取得了最高的任务成功率（3……
tldr: LeadVLA提出一种结构化多模态策略，将路线保留为显式路径参考并学习推进节奏与局部自适应残差，从而实现持续适应跟随者的机器人领行，并配套了约400万样本的数据生成基础设施LeadInfra和含108个留出回合的标准化基准LeadBench。
en_tdlr: LeadVLA introduces a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit path reference while learning a pace and residual for follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation, enabling follower-aware robot leading, supported by a ~4M-sample data infrastructure (LeadInfra) and a standardized benchmark (LeadBench).
